spec_basis.quote: A TOR is generated when any of the following transactions is unsuccessful: POS Purchase/Capture transaction, CAT Purchase/Capture transaction, Mail/Phone Purchase transaction
The Sequence Number of a TOR must be the same as the Sequence Number of the financial transaction being reversed.
A TOR should never be attempted more than 3 times.
The customer's host/controller/POS system should continue to send the TOR-subject to health message rules-to BUYPASS until a valid response is received.
03 MasterCard - Authorizer Type: Credit
The following point-of-sale transactions are supported for credit card processing: ... Purchase/Capture
